title.en: Tale 3 — The Pot That Gave Birth

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: Juha borrowed a big pot from the neighbour.

sentences.ar: כשהוא החזיר אותו, הוא שם בתוכו סיר קטן.
sentences.en: When he returned it, he put a small pot inside it.

sentences.ar: השכן שאל: מה זה הקטן הזה?
sentences.en: The neighbour asked: what is this small one?
Juha said: your pot gave birth.
The neighbour was happy and took both.

sentences.ar: אחרי שבוע הוא לקח את הסיר שוב.
sentences.en: A week later he borrowed the pot again.
This time he did not return it.

sentences.ar: השכן שאל עליו והוא אמר: הוא מת.
sentences.en: The neighbour asked about it and he said: it died.
The neighbour said: a pot does not die!
Juha said: you believed that it gives birth.
And you do not believe that it dies?
